title: A run of the site backup test suite leaves no anonymous MariaDB volume behind
steps: S1: From the repo root at the commit under test, with a docker daemon: record the set of dangling volumes (docker volume ls -q -f dangling=true), then run node --test --test-reporter=tap packages/fleet/tracy-fleet-operation/test/site-backup.test.mjs, then record the set again.
S2: For each volume in the second set and not in the first, check whether it holds MariaDB data files (/ibdata1).
expect: S1: the suite exits 0 with fail 0, cancelled 0, skipped 0 (the MariaDB tests ran against a real server).
S2: no new dangling volume holds MariaDB data files (pre-fix: one per run, because mariadb:11 declares VOLUME /var/lib/mysql and the throwaway container was removed with docker rm -f without -v).
evidence: Measured 15/10/2026 on a local checkout: dangling volumes 6 -> 7 around one run on the parent commit, the new volume holding aria_log, ibdata1, mysql/; 7 -> 7 after the fix.
fence: packages/fleet/tracy-fleet-operation/test/site-backup.test.mjs: both removals of the throwaway MariaDB container use docker rm -f -v.
